## Class Setting {.smaller}
- One Course at a Time
  - 18 class days including finals
  - 4 hours per day
  - Students take, and faculty teach ... one course at a time
- 11 students
- all sophomores
- no pre-requisites
- Community Partners
  - Primary: [Waypoint](https://www.waypointservices.org/)
  - Secondary: [Iowa Legal Aid](https://www.iowalegalaid.org/)

## Collaborative classroom

![](../images/classroom.jpg)
 
## Course Creation Timeline {.smaller}

- October 2022: Contacted Civic Engagement Office

- November 2022: Met with Waypoint to Discuss Ideas

- February 2023: Decided on Research Questions

- July 2023: Iowa Legal Aid Joined

- Early August 2023: Met to determine final asks and to discuss a community partner agreement

- Mid-August 2023: Set course details

- End August 2023: Received data, login information provided, and class started

## Course Organization {.smaller}

- General outline
  - Engage with materials to understand disparity and inequity
  - Training by community patterns to use their websites and data
  - Descriptive statistics
  - Start group project

- Throughout
  - Relevant talks
  - Podcasts and videos
  - Reflection and course discussions

## Pedagogy {.smaller}

- Engage -> Reflect -> Group discussion followed by whole class discussion

- Collaborative learning
  - The class was divided into 3 groups
  - Each group then divided tasks
  - TV on the wall to work on the same website
  - Each day those tasks rotated
  - Example: 1 - Controlling source website, 2 - typing record from the website, 3 - facilitating watching person typing to verify the record, 4 - working on report and/or presentation 

- Presentations - students had to present progress on multiple occasions and the final project was presented to the community partner

## Unprecedented Difficulties {.smaller}

- Waypoint was great but I didn't receive the data and sign-in information until the week before class started. 
- Transportation
- Only 2 sets of login information
- Students had to sign a type of confidentiality agreement (not a formal NDA)
- Picking software for data visualization
- Recording consistency

## Give Back
- Students gave a final presentation to partners
- I found and fixed some student errors in data, then wrote metadata for all data files and turned it all back to Waypoint

# The End - Thank you!
